rows.quote: The present study was approved by UK Biobank under application number 19542.
rows.coder_note: Rule C: the authors analyse UK Biobank individual-level phenotypic and genetic data under application number 19542, with outcomes defined by them (Fried frailty phenotype adapted to UK Biobank data); no published GWAS release, accession or citation is named and no dictionary row is this analysis. The data availability sentence occurs twice in the source and the occurrence helper raised for it, so the application number sentence is pinned.
